name: compare-slider
title: Compare Slider
description: A before and after comparison: two pictures in one rounded frame with a white divider and handle that people drag, or move with the arrow keys, to reveal more of either, and a corner label on each side. Built on react-compare-slider. Takes the before and after pictures, an optional starting position and a frame shape.

meta.use_when: People judge a change to the same picture, such as an upscale, a relight or a retouch
